challenge.heading: Breaking through operational bottlenecks in HCP engagement
challenge.body:
A biotech company with growing operations across 10 European markets faced significant frustration with their HCP engagement approval process. Medical affairs and Commercial Teams spent days processing activity requests, only to face weeks of back-and-forth iterations with compliance, legal, and finance.

The manual process created delays that meant missed opportunities for timely scientific exchange, frustrated field teams who felt disconnected from decision-making, and compliance teams overwhelmed by fragmented documentation across email chains and spreadsheets. The organization needed a solution that would preserve necessary controls while dramatically reducing friction.

approach.heading: A user-centric platform prioritizing efficiency and transparency
approach.intro: Rather than implementing a heavy enterprise system, we designed a streamlined solution focused on eliminating waste in the approval journey:

items.title: Process Reengineering
items.description: Mapped and streamlined end-to-end workflows across all markets, removing redundant approval steps while maintaining necessary controls. Created standardized process that captured required information upfront, eliminating multiple rounds of clarification.

items.title: Open-Source Technology Stack
items.description: Deployed a modern, open-source platform that automated routing, notifications, compliance checks and documentation. The system integrated seamlessly with an external HCP payment platform and the internal contract management system, eliminating manual data re-entry and reducing errors.

items.title: User Experience Focus
items.description: Designed interfaces that field teams could navigate intuitively on computer or mobile phone without extensive training. Progressive disclosure ensured users only saw fields relevant to their activity type, while built-in validation caught common errors immediately rather than after approval submission.

items.title: Embedded Compliance & Efficiency
items.description: Built compliance rules directly into the workflow engine, automatically routing activities to appropriate reviewers based on activity type, budget, and country regulations. Real-time dashboards gave all stakeholders visibility into approval status, eliminating "where is my request" inquiries.
